text.description_html:
Michael Healy MHS33, Bay Scallop Front Door Knocker in Oiled Bronze

Micheal Healy's Bay Scallop Door Knocker in Oiled Bronze is a great addition to any beach front home. Its beautiful detailing makes it so much more than a door knocker, its door jewelry that shows off your personality before your guests even knock on the door. The Bay Scallop Front Door Knocker in Oiled Bronze comes packaged with everything you'll need to surface mount it on your door.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Oiled Bronze Polished Brass with Brown Patina Nickel Silver

Also Available: larger 5" Oiled Bronze Sea Scallop Door Knocker

Features and Specifications of the Oiled Bronze Bay Scallop Standard Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 3-7/10"
  • Width: 3-9/10"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 2-3/10"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-1/2"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
